news.title: Akamai Recognized in Forrester Zero Trust Report
news.text: The Forrester Wave: Zero Trust Platforms Q3 2025 report cited Akamai as a customer favorite, underscoring the company's strong position in zero-trust security.

news.title: Customer Trust Spotlight on Zero Trust Platforms
news.text: Akamai emphasized how customer feedback contributed to its distinction as a favorite vendor in 2025 Zero Trust platform evaluations.

news.title: Extortion Evolves: Akamai SOTI Report
news.text: Akamai released its State of the Internet report detailing the increasing complexity of ransomware attacks and extortion schemes.

news.title: Akamai Reports Q2 2025 Earnings Beat
news.text: The company delivered second-quarter 2025 revenue of $1.043 billion and EPS of $1.73, exceeding expectations and motivating an increased annual outlook.

news.title: Reuters Highlights Akamai's Security Momentum
news.text: Following earnings, Reuters noted Akamai's continued momentum in security and cloud computing businesses.

news.title: Akamai Partners with Aptum to Scale Cloud Journeys
news.text: Akamai and Aptum announced a partnership focused on helping customers accelerate cloud migrations and improve performance.

news.title: Akamai and Seraphic Collaborate on Secure Browsing
news.text: The company teamed with Seraphic to simplify secure service edge deployments through secure enterprise browsing.

news.title: Akamai Consolidates Global Partner Program
news.text: Akamai streamlined its partner program with localized tiering and targeted incentives to drive channel growth.

news.title: Akamai CEO Receives Emmy Award
news.text: Akamai announced that its CEO earned an Emmy Award recognizing technological contributions to broadcasting.

news.title: Akamai Introduces Inference Cloud
news.text: Akamai announced general availability of the Akamai Inference Cloud, a distributed edge platform built with NVIDIA GPUs to deliver low-latency AI inference workloads.

news.title: Akamai Highlights Edge AI Transformation
news.text: Further detailing the initiative, Akamai described how its Inference Cloud transforms AI deployments from core to edge using NVIDIA technology.
